work_item: BODY-1 BB-CONTEXT CSV table comparison explanation consumer and no-resend recovery
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: An actual keyed CSV-to-CSV comparison -> ordinary same-case ExplainPrevious -> exact sealed-input/report replay -> two-sided source-range explanation -> local-file recovery without resend

implementation.recognition: The consumer loads the previous result input by actor, case, input ID and version, and selects this route only for a retained sealed Intent::CsvCompare. A missing bundle paired with the exact CSV comparison report shape is a typed integrity stop.
implementation.replay: It recomputes document::csv_compare_by from the sealed source and key, then verifies the canonical DocumentResult bytes, sole prior report dependency, prior text, source/output SHA-256 values, ContentPlan identity/text/guarantee, RenderObservation, and both stored plan/render artifact bytes.
implementation.explanation: It reports equality/change counts under exact decoded-string comparison and explains up to eight changes. Changed cells map matching left/right keys and original rows to the selected column cells; added/removed rows show up to eight original cells. Each displayed source range is checked against the sealed input and output JSON string token and includes a raw-byte SHA-256. No numeric, semantic or factual equivalence is inferred.
implementation.core_graph: Core links the prior result, sealed input-bundle hash and report hash using new previous-csv-table-comparison-input/report nodes, with the report requiring the sealed input node.
implementation.recovery: The fixture runs the real CSV producer and explanation with an authorized local output, keeps the actual post-render/pre-receipt journal and written file, drops the Engine, then reconciles. It confirms the same three dependencies and report lineage, unchanged bytes and modification time, and one confirmed effect without resending.
stops: A non-CsvCompare sealed intent is not interpreted as a CSV comparison explanation.
Missing or changed sealed input, report artifact, prior text, ContentPlan, RenderObservation, dependency lineage, source range or output token yields a typed stop.
Explanations over the request evidence budget return RESOURCE_LIMIT.

producer_consumer: Ordinary Japanese CSV-to-CSV keyed comparison -> existing exact-string CSV_TABLE_COMPARE report with left/right source spans -> same-case 詳しく説明して -> sealed-input/report/content/render replay -> bounded two-sided source explanation and dependency graph -> authorized local-file receipt -> reconciliation confirms without resend.

normal_cli_route.observed: The Japanese route consumes the actual CSV_TABLE_COMPARE producer result, checks two changed cells, one removed row and one added row, validates displayed raw ranges and hashes, exact prior/input/report dependencies, graph edge and render hash, and then checks an equal-table case through the English command form.

recovery_route.observed: The combined structured-table recovery regression includes the CSV comparison explanation. It checks the explanation marker, sealed-input/report lineage and three dependencies, then confirms the existing output bytes and modification time and one original confirmed action without a second write.
recovery_route.process_boundary: The test drops the Engine and reopens Store state for reconciliation within the same test process; no separate-process claim is made.

At most eight changes are expanded; one-sided rows show up to eight cells each, while the complete report remains in its immutable artifact.
The route compares exact decoded strings and does not establish numeric, semantic or factual equivalence.
The full workspace runtime suite and complete B04/A07/A14/E08 acceptance remain NOT_RUN/UNVERIFIED.
